pre_wiring_assumptions.blocking_composition_decision: SQL governance publish_committed callbacks append the governance pool's spine_events and return its seq. An independent FakeSpine behind EventBus does not contain those commits and owns a different sequence authority. All-fake bus+SQL-governance pairing therefore needs an explicit PM decision before wiring; same-memory-pool SQL Spine is compatible, separate FakeSpine is not. No silent promotion or fake success implemented.
pre_wiring_assumptions.startup: subscribe_live attaches on first future poll, before cold reconciliation; creating/spawning the future alone is not an observer-ready receipt. Pre-attachment outcomes are recovered durably; concurrent outcomes are buffered. No startup handshake is exposed.
pre_wiring_assumptions.captured_arcs: Governance captures store/bus/packet_dir/mutation mutex; RoleService captures registry/store/bus; DeliveryService captures registry/queue/transport/InteractionGate/bus/clock/native lock. Replacing Services fields requires rebuilding captured dependents. Handlers read remaining ports from AppState at call time.
